claim.statement: The council leader polls a Git repository (every 30 s by default), reconciles apps, namespaces and permissions including deletions, undoes manual drift, and can require signed commits.

sources.quote: Point the config at a repository and the council leader keeps the cluster in
a GitOps-managed app by hand and the next poll puts it back

claim.measurable: Push a commit changing replicas; the cluster converges within poll_interval_secs (30). Edit a GitOps-managed app by hand; the next poll reverts it. Delete an app from the repo; it is removed. An unsigned commit is not applied when require_signed_commits = true. A git command running over 2 minutes is killed and retried. Any [job.*] declaration refuses the whole commit.
interfaces: [gitops] repo, branch, path, poll_interval_secs, require_signed_commits, trusted_signing_keys, webhook_secret
dashboard GitOps page (no relish gitops command)
